notes.title: Early Access Update
notes.content:
Just a quick note to let you know that work continues to improve Blight of the Immortals here on Steam. 

We would like to try and improve the games framerate before doing a full release. On most platforms, even phones and tables, we see a very smooth framerate, but here on Steam there is a problem that makes the interface feel laggy and unresponsive unless you have a very fast computer. 

Unfortunately the bug is in our underlying game engine, so we have our fingers crossed that they will be able to fix this issue soon and that we can get a new version out to you as soon as possible. 

Some of you may also have noticed that we changed the games font to make it easier to read, and there have been a number of other small ui changes. 

Thanks again for playing!
